NC-002.reason: The hardcoded scrypt master key, encryptValue and the AES decrypt are removed from config_tool.js (no callers left). Config values SECRET:<NAME> resolve from the shared store through secret_manager.readRawSecret; legacy ENC: values resolve to null with an error that names the key (fail closed). Secret-like keys and store references stay in process memory and are no longer written to the shared global_var directory. The ncore/apps ENC: blobs (Voice USER_API_CLIENT_TOKEN, openai o_secret) became store references, and both consumers load through importConfigFromJs, so they get the resolved value. No ENC: literal remains under ncore/ or apps/. The root config/index.js blobs are outside ncore scope and were requested from the orchestrator.

NC-024.reason: importConfigFromJs no longer reads or rewrites the tracked config file; the content.replace(plaintext, ENC) rewrite is gone.

NC-033.reason: The OCR.space and Unsplash keys come from the store (OCRSPACE_API_KEY_1..5, UNSPLASH_ACCESS_KEY_1..5 via pycore get_secret_key_indexed); the committed copies (three OCR, two Unsplash, plus the Unsplash secret and app id) are removed. The rotation list is in the owner report without values.

issues: (non-blocking, user action) Hosts that ran the old code still hold ENC: files in their global_var directory, decryptable with the now-public old master key. Remove those files once, and rotate every secret in the owner's rotation table (the values are in git history).

ncore/foundation/common/secret_manager.js readRawSecret (non-blocking) joins keyName into the raw dir without validating it. Names come from tracked config today, but reject anything that is not [A-Za-z0-9_] (the Laravel SecretStore rule) to keep SECRET:<NAME> from reading outside the store.
(orchestrator) config/index.js still carries ENC: values, which now resolve to null until they are converted to SECRET:<NAME> references.
checks: Diffs of config_tool.js, secret_manager.js, the Voice config, the openai config, the OCR/Unsplash python files read; grep for encryptValue callers and remaining ENC: literals under ncore/apps; gconfig and openai config load paths traced to importConfigFromJs; no secret values written anywhere by the change.
